name: User Temporary Files
description: Temporary working files and installers left behind in user AppData Temp.
description_benefit: Frees up gigabytes of accumulated temporary files from old app runs.

name: Windows System Temp
description: System-level temporary files created by Windows background tasks and updates.
description_benefit: Recovers system drive capacity without touching running services.

name: Application Crash Dumps
description: Crash dump memory logs (*.dmp) created when apps terminate unexpectedly.
description_benefit: Reclaims hundreds of megabytes of old debugging dumps.

name: Delivery Optimization Cache
description: Cached Windows Update peer-to-peer download pieces.
description_benefit: Safely clears peer-to-peer update cache pieces.

name: Windows Update Download Cache
description: Installer packages downloaded for updates that have already been applied.
description_benefit: Reclaims multi-gigabyte leftovers from past Windows Updates.

name: DirectX / GPU Shader Cache
description: Compiled graphics pipeline shaders. Recompiles automatically when games launch.
description_benefit: Cleans corrupted or outdated graphics shader caches.

name: Microsoft Edge Web Cache
description: Cached images, styles, and scripts from Edge browser.
description_benefit: Frees browser cache without affecting bookmarks or saved passwords.

name: Google Chrome Web Cache
description: Cached images, styles, and scripts from Chrome browser.
description_benefit: Frees browser cache without affecting bookmarks or saved passwords.
